facts.fact: The mHealth Africa article says DHIS2 (the national database known as SIGSANTE) is the backbone of Côte d'Ivoire's National Health Information System and has centralised routine health data since its deployment in 2015.

The article says that since 2018 the national DHIS2 has integrated vaccination, epidemiological surveillance and community data flows, and that the mHealth community platform transmits data to it via HL7 FHIR APIs.

systems.owner: Health Information Directorate (DIS), Ministry of Health

note: Lists only digital health strategy instruments (PSSIS 2021-2025, PSSD 2026-2030 in budgeting); states nothing about a health management information system in service, underway, linked or its reporting rate.
DHIS2 is named as a data source only; the abstract does not say that a national system is in service or what facilities report through it.
Describes a community health platform in one region, not the national HMIS.
No national routine reporting system named.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that Cote d'Ivoire's National Health Data Platform gives a single access point, including an API, to official health indicators compiled from the national health information system.
